sinopsis.es: La vida de Michèle Firk —periodista, crítica de cine, aspirante a directora y militante comunista francesa, pionera, implicada en varias luchas de liberación de la segunda mitad del siglo XX— contada por la voz de Alice Diop.
sinopsis.en: The life of Michèle Firk — a trailblazing French journalist, film critic, aspiring director and communist activist involved in various liberation struggles in the second half of the 20th century — as told by narrator Alice Diop, modern day French director.
